meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案：先解析诗句的意象、情感、时代与手法，再给出2-3组配图场景描述，最后按Suno格式提供纯音乐风格标签与结构指令。
howto.when: 当你需要为古诗词配图、配乐，或制作诗词MV时触发，比如提到某首诗并说“配张图”“写段音乐”。

say.text: 给李白的《静夜思》做一版配图和配乐。
say.note: 会得到画面描述和Suno音乐蓝图。

say.text: 把王维《山居秋暝》设计成水墨风，配宁静的古筝乐曲。
解析苏轼《水调歌头》的意象，生成配图和音乐结构。
say.note: 先深挖意境再输出完整方案。

howto.what_en: Creates visual and musical blueprints for classical Chinese poems: analyzes imagery, emotion, era and technique, offers 2-3 scene descriptions, then provides Suno-style tags and structural instructions for instrumental music.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for an illustration, soundtrack, or MV for a classical poem — e.g., mentioning a poem and asking for 'a picture' or 'a piece of music'.

say_en.text: Create an illustration and soundtrack for Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thought'.
say_en.note: You'll get scene descriptions and a Suno music blueprint.

say_en.text: Design Wang Wei's 'Dwelling in Autumn Hills' in ink-wash style with calm guzheng music.
say_en.note: Focuses on unified style and mood.

say_en.text: Analyze the imagery of Su Shi's 'Water Melody' and generate visuals and music structure.
say_en.note: Deep interpretation first, then a full plan.
